desc:
🦾 Drop your claw into the boss's nest, grab a giant egg and run it home before the boss catches you! Hatch rare pets that earn Cash across 19 zones.

👍 Like & favorite the game, and join the Claw = Egg group for +10% Cash & Claw Power forever!

How to Play:
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Pets earn Cash on your farm, even while you're offline
⬆️ Train on Claw Trainers to grow your Claw Power
🗺️ Unlock 19 zones with rarer eggs
✨ Collect claw skins with unique effects
🔮 Find rare sizes and mutations
🧪 Fuse 3 pets into a new one

Free Stuff:
🥚 Free Colossal Egg every day
🎁 Daily rewards, playtime gifts & quests
🎡 A free spin every 15 minutes
🌟 Golden, Ruby & Diamond Hours for lucky eggs!
👫 Play with friends for bonus Cash

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

TAGS: steal eggs, steal, eggs, claw, hatch, pets, animals, run, simulator
